label: A research desk in one live space: a probe that asks Claude on its own, a paper put on the board that flips a claim everywhere, then a page written on the spot that starts a real eval run.

chapters.title: Open the desk
chapters.note: A team's papers, claims and runs, live in one space.

chapters.title: The probe asks
chapters.note: A job asks Claude on its own. The answer lands.

chapters.title: Weigh a paper
chapters.note: Link a paper against a claim, right on its page.

chapters.title: Every page knows
chapters.note: Doubtful now on the board, the sidebar and its page.

chapters.title: Make a page
chapters.note: A few lines set the papers against our own runs.

chapters.title: Run it again
chapters.note: Press it: a real eval starts, the whole desk knows.

chapters.title: Answers land
chapters.note: The leaderboard and the run's page fill as it answers.
